environment.name: RUDI_OUTPUT_DIR
environment.purpose: Override the root output directory. Defaults to ~/.rudi/output.

environment.name: AUDIO_TOOLS_OUTPUT_DIR
environment.purpose: Override transcript JSON and Markdown output directory.

environment.name: AUDIO_TOOLS_DB_PATH
environment.purpose: Override the SQLite transcript index path.

environment.name: AUDIO_TOOLS_WHISPER_MODEL
environment.purpose: Override local Whisper model path. Defaults to ~/.rudi/models/whisper/ggml-base.en.bin.

environment.name: AUDIO_TOOLS_AGENT_NAME
environment.purpose: Name of the local enrichment agent.

environment.name: AUDIO_TOOLS_AGENT_MODEL
environment.purpose: Model used by the local enrichment agent command.

environment.name: AUDIO_TOOLS_PROMPT_TEMPLATE
environment.purpose: Path to the enrichment prompt template.

environment.name: AUDIO_TOOLS_CONFIG
environment.purpose: Path to a JSON config file merged over portable defaults.

notes: No API credentials are required for local transcription.
ffmpeg, ffprobe, yt-dlp, whisper-cli, and the Whisper model must be visible to the actual MCP server runtime, which may be separate from an agent's interactive shell.
This file documents names and purposes only; never store secret values here.
